scope: Generated native-layout preview cache freshness; not visual approval of decks or shipped thumbnails

identity_inputs: Current generator executable SHA256, memoized within its process
Resolved LibreOffice entrypoint path, bytes and reported version
Resolved rasterizer entrypoint path, bytes and reported version
Effective DPI, with default and nonpositive values normalized to96
Ordered native layout IDs and effective sample-content recipe
implementation.migration: Legacy template-only cache directories are not reused or deleted
implementation.version_probe: Five-second context deadline and one-second pipe wait bound; failed, cancelled or empty version is an error, not permission to reuse stale PNGs

local_gates.actual_render_and_cache_regression: PASS under bundled LibreOffice: same request keeps paths and file timestamps;72to144DPI uses different cache paths and doubles width/height for every layout

resolved_gaps: Cache test previously asserted only image count; now checks reuse and unmodified timestamps
Real DPI separation and actual decoded PNG dimensions checked
Generator, template, renderer, recipe and DPI identity changes checked independently
Unchanged wrapper with changed target version tested
Missing/unexecutable renderer, missing template, failed/empty/cancelled version probes fail closed
Engine fingerprint checked against actual executable bytes
residual_risks: Unit identity separation and rendering controls are not full-deck visual or editability approval

resolved_scenarios: Same template with rebuilt generator reuses outdated PNGs: executable identity included
Same template requested at different density reuses wrong-resolution PNGs: effective DPI included
Wrapper entrypoint unchanged while renderer upgraded: reported version included
Same template with a changed native preview recipe collides: effective slide specifications included
Renderer identification fails and stale evidence is returned: error propagated
residual_risks: Font installation or other ambient rendering-environment changes are not individually fingerprinted
Live replacement of an executable before its first fingerprint is outside this cache contract
Existing full LibreOffice conversion and rasterization process behavior is unchanged; this change bounds version identification only
